messages:
jena: Quick sync — Manila region onboarding. Updated the connectivity doc with proposed egress IP pools and KMS residency notes. Need clear owners for egress IPs, KMS key creation, and DB replica read routing. Canary planned for Tue next week.

omar: I can own egress IPs + firewall exceptions. I'll open the infra PR today and drop the CIDR list in the doc.

kevin: I can handle KMS. Question: do we want customer KMS in-region (PH) or use centralized key with residency controls? My preference is in-region for compliance, but needs ops runbook.

lia: For DB read replicas, platform needs to validate replica lag under load. I can take the validation tests if someone wires up the replica.

omar: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/terraform/pulls/8423 — adds manila/egress-pools and firewall modules. PTAL @jena @kevin. Includes example:
```
resource "rg_egress_pool" "manila" {
  region = "asia-southeast-1"
  cidrs  = ["34.120.10.0/28", "34.120.11.0/28"]
}
```

jena: Thanks @omar — I'll review tonight. @kevin if we go in-region KMS we need a KMS policy template. Can you post a short checklist (keys, rotation, HSM if required)?

kevin: Will do. Draft checklist in comments of PR 8423 by EOD. Quick note: for in-region keys we need IAM role for cross-account access from our private control plane; raising a ticket to cloud-ops.

lia: For the replica tests I need the canary plan details (qps target, payload sizes). @jena can you paste the canary SLOs?

jena: Canary SLOs: 95th < 120ms median token latency, 99th < 450ms; target QPS 50 sustained for 10m, peak bursts 200 for 1m. Payloads: small chat (64 tokens), long-completion (1024 prompt + 256 gen). Add to doc: https://docs.internal.redwood/regions/manila-connectivity

oncall-bot: Reminder — scheduled maintenance window for asia-southeast-1 on 2026-05-12 02:00-04:00 UTC. Automated failover checks will run.

omar: Noted maintenance window. I'll ensure egress rules and health checks are ready before Tue canary.

kevin: Filed cloud-ops ticket for KMS role: CH-1294. Linking it in PR comments.

jena: Action items summary: 1) Omar -> infra PR (egress + firewall) — in progress (PR 8423). 2) Kevin -> KMS checklist + ticket (CH-1294). 3) Lia -> replica perf tests and scenario doc. 4) Jena -> review infra PR, finalize canary plan. We'll reconvene async here by EOD tomorrow for status. :thumbsup:

omar: Ack.

lia: Ack, starting test plan now.

kevin: Ack, will post checklist soon.
